note: Unknown data types on hosts that have no idea what they mean, including the SAME type on a waypoint and on an area, two records of one type on one host (which spec 5 leaves to the reader), and a deeply nested opaque body. An unknown type is inert on any host: no diagnostic, no error. The round trip this runner performs is what proves the bodies survive read-modify-write at value level rather than being flattened or dropped.
